sourceRefs.locator: Ch. 4 in the translation of Cave and Coulson, p. 130. Separate prices for ordinary grain and the king’s stocks, numbers and weight of loaves, and the final provision on unfree dependants.
Date and editions, Boretius, no. 28, pp. 73–78; ch. 4, grain and baked bread at Frankfurt in 794.

labels.de: Wie viele Brote sollte ein Denar kaufen?
labels.en: How many loaves should a denarius buy?

alt.de: Vorgeschriebene Stückzahlen in Kapitel 4 von 794. Für einen Denar sollten Käufer zwölf Weizenbrote, fünfzehn Roggenbrote, zwanzig Gerstenbrote oder fünfundzwanzig Haferbrote zu jeweils zwei damaligen Pfund erhalten.
alt.en: Prescribed quantities in chapter 4 of the 794 ordinance. One denarius was to buy twelve wheat, fifteen rye, twenty barley or twenty-five oat loaves, each weighing two pounds of the period.
